module.note: QPU apparatus + supply of electronics inside the cryostat (electrical); cold_heat_load_w is thermal power at the cryostat stages and is NOT wall power

system.note: complete quantum computer incl. cryostat compressors, control electronics, decoders, host; excludes facility cooling, networking and building overhead

facility.note: (system + network/support) x PUE; PUE covers heat rejection incl. chilled water for the compressors

boundary_note: total_power_w and power_w are the SYSTEM boundary (complete quantum computer); facility_power_w is (system + network/support) x PUE; power_boundaries.module separates the QPU module and the thermal cold-stage heat load (not wall power)
